label: patched-upstream-tests
scope: TEST CODE ONLY (unit_test/*.hpp). No production source, no expectation, no tolerance and no input deck is changed; every EXPECT_* and its expected value is kept verbatim.
status: NOT part of the frozen source artifact and NOT part of the release payload; applied only in the private test workspace used for this attribution. The frozen archive, its source_tree_sha256 and all nine other artifacts are unchanged.
if_adopted: adopting these patches into the benchmark source would produce a NEW source_version, a new source_tree_sha256 and a new artifact; the current identity would not be overwritten.
apply: patch -p1 -d <copy of level3/exaca/src> < <patch>  (a copy, never the materialized canonical tree)

patches.reason: create_mirror_view_and_copy(TEST_MEMSPACE(), grain_id_host) rebinds the local `grain_id` handle to a NEW device View, so the fixture's initial grain IDs 1/2/3 never reach celldata's own grain-ID subview, which nucleateGrain and the assertions read. Confirmed by instrumentation: aliases_celldata=0, celldata_subview[2,6,8]=0,0,0 while the local handle held 1,2,3. Fixed by deep_copy into celldata.getGrainIDSubview(grid).
create_mirror_view (no copy) is read as if it held the kernel's result; on CUDA it reads uninitialised host memory. Fixed by create_mirror_view_and_copy.

three problems: the same grain-ID subview aliasing as tstNucleation; calcCritDiagonalLength and createNewOctahedron (KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTIONs writing device Views) are called from host loops; and the DEVICE view octahedron_center_test (label "DOCenter") is indexed on the host for their arguments. Fixed by writing into celldata's subview and by running the same calls/expressions inside kernels.

verification.method: each suite run before and after the patch through the validated launcher (one GPU per rank), same binary otherwise
verification.cuda_after_patch: 23/23 tests pass (all suites, np1/2/4 where applicable)
verification.serial_after_patch: 23/23 tests pass in a separate Serial-only Kokkos build
